{{Quote|We need to bring the Jedi into line, Chief, before it's too late. If they'll go after Admiral Bwua'tu, they'll go after you.|Rynog Asokaji|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
'''Rynog Asokaji''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] and the aide-de-camp of the [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]], [[Chief of Naval Operations|Chief]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Galactic Alliance Navy]]. When an [[Attempted assassination of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu|assassination attempt]] left Bwua'tu in a coma, Asokaji at first blamed [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] for the act in retaliation for Bwua'tu's attempt to make a deal with interim [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]] to allow the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] to launch their [[StealthX]]s. Daala merely praised him for his bravery and requested that he ask permission to speak freely with her in the future, and the two came to be on good terms. Asokaji later suspected that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were behind the attack, although Daala and her [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]], [[Wynn Dorvan]], remained dubious. Asokaji offered to send 5,000 [[Galactic Alliance Marines|marines]] against the Jedi if Daala so wished, but she declined.

When Bwua'tu regained consciousness, Asokaji was delighted to see him again and was one of the few, along with Bwu'tu's uncle [[Eramuth Bwua'tu]], Wynn Dorvan, and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to know that he was still fully functional. Knowing that a conspiracy had targeted him, Bwua'tu feigned brain damage. Brainstorming between Dorvan and Bwua'tu over the recent events, namely the [[Plan Delta|coup]] that overthrew Daala, led them to deduce that Bwua'tu's replacement, Admiral [[Sallinor Parova]], was a part of the conspiracy. With assistance from Han Solo, Asokaji kidnapped Parova and they imprisonned her in the Jedi Temple. There, Dorvan, Bwua'tu and Asokaji interrogated Parova but she refused to tell them anything. A few moments after they left her, she was killed by members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].
